The historical producer first interpolates density linearly in radius, then samples and writes that distinct log-log table. Exact radial-linear integrals separate smoothing from finite table sampling.

reference_input_representation.limits: Input tables only: no Cloudy execution, zoning, matched lower angular illumination, IR/diffuse closure, rates, radiation or spectra.
